description.en: Read a repository's design documents (docs/rfd/NNNN-slug.md): a list by last update with state filters, full-text search, review comments beside the lines they refer to, previews of linked RFDs, a Cmd-/ jump-to, and a new RFD as a pull request without a clone.

scopes.integration:github:read: Read the RFD files, their pull requests and review comments through your own GitHub sign-in.
scopes.storage:local: Keep the RFDs you read, so the list opens at once and works offline.
scopes.workspace:write: Open a pull request or a link in a browser tab when you click it.
